visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark, permed curly hair, wearing a navy blue blazer over a white V-neck t-shirt, stands in a brightly lit indoor studio. He gestures toward his head with his hands. Yellow cartoon sunray stickers and red angry-face icons are overlaid around his hair as he speaks. Behind him are white shelves and a red frame-like structure. (2) A static graphic icon of a woman's face appears on the left side of the screen. The man continues to talk and touch his hair, looking slightly annoyed. Additional graphics comparing his likeness to celebrities appear, including photos of actors Song Kang and Elvis Tsui, with percentage ratings overlaid. (3) The screen divides vertically into a split-screen effect. The man stands in the center, and as he moves his hand across the screen, the visual filter toggles: on one side, he has a full beard and mustache, and on the other, he is clean-shaven. He looks into the camera, comparing both looks. (4) The split-screen remains active as the man begins to lip-sync to a song. He uses his hands to mimic singing into a microphone. On-screen text indicates the song title and artist. He smiles and moves rhythmically before finally leaning back and exiting the frame at the bottom.
